size_why: Comeback economy rework plus a broad invis-item reshuffle and targeted nerfs.
headline: Comebacks get weaker and Veil Walker dies; tempo picks rise.

meta_thesis.previous: Scaling and comeback mechanics kept games open.
meta_thesis.new: Early leads convert more reliably as comeback souls move into tick gold.
meta_thesis.why: Comeback soul redistribution and bounty increases favor snowballing.

winners.why: Sprint and targeting changes plus Shadow Weave buffs.

losers.why: Card Trick nerfs plus losing Veil Walker.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The 'general' slow reduction is really a Wraith/Haze nerf.

uncertainties: How much tick gold compensates losing teams.
what_to_watch: Wraith win rate in the first week.
